scenes.text: Somewhere in your house, there's a drawer.
scenes.say: [storytelling] Somewhere in your house... there's a drawer.
scenes.head: THE DRAWER WORTH $27 BILLION

scenes.text: Hello? Anyone? It's been two years!
scenes.say: [whiny] Hello? Anyone?! It's been two YEARS!

scenes.text: That's a gift card. Unused. And it is not alone.
scenes.say: [deadpan] That's a gift card. Unused. And it is not alone.

scenes.text: A 2024 Bankrate survey: 43% of U.S. adults have at least one.
scenes.say: A twenty twenty-four Bankrate survey: forty-three percent of U.S. adults have at least one.
scenes.show_source: Bankrate / YouGov survey, Aug 2024 (2,373 U.S. adults)

scenes.say: [surprised] Their average stash? Two hundred forty-four bucks.

scenes.text: Two hundred forty-four dollars of ME! Just sitting here!
scenes.say: [sobbing] Two hundred forty-four dollars of ME! Just... sitting here!

scenes.text: Now add up every drawer in America.
scenes.say: Now... add up every drawer in America.
[amazed] About twenty-seven billion dollars. That's Bankrate's estimate.

scenes.text: And 1 in 5 adults let a card expire before using it.
scenes.say: And one in five adults let a card expire before using it.

scenes.text: Wait, how long have I been in here?
scenes.say: [nervous] Wait... how long have I been in here?

scenes.text: So which card is hiding in YOUR drawer?
